items.name: nexus-font
items.title: Nexus UI Inter Font
items.description: Inter font setup used by Nexus UI components so installed components match the preview typography.

items.name: ui-sounds
items.title: UI Sounds
items.description: 24 interface sound effects synthesised with the Web Audio API. One file, no audio assets.

items.name: scroll-progress-bar
items.title: Scroll Progress Bar
items.description: A progress rail for long reads: the fill springs after your scroll, a bead rides its tip and stretches with your speed, and each milestone dot pops in as you pass it. It tracks the page, a section or a scrollable panel, runs vertical or horizontal, and optional chapter labels jump to their part of the page.

items.name: wheel-selector
items.title: Wheel Selector
items.description: A radial selector: a ring of icon nodes you drag round, fling, scroll or step with the arrow keys. It coasts, snaps to the nearest stop with a little overshoot, and the node at the top swells and fills with its colour while the hub counter rolls and the side panel swaps to that item.

items.name: cinematic-card-deck
items.title: Cinematic Card Deck
items.description: A deck of poster cards in 3D: the front card peels away on its bottom edge while the cards behind rise to take its place, leaning back as the deck moves and springing upright when it stops. Swipe or fling it, scroll the wheel over it, use the arrow keys or the progress pills, or set scrollLinked to deal it from page scroll.

items.name: cursor-text-reveal
items.title: Cursor Text Reveal
items.description: An ink lens follows the pointer across a card and shows a second sentence through it, dragging a tail of droplets on looser and looser springs so fast moves stretch into a drip. Press and hold (or Space) to flood the whole card with the reveal; it lets go with an overshoot.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone Input
items.description: A phone number field with a searchable country picker that formats the number in each country's own pattern. Digits drop into place with a small overshoot, a hairline fills toward a complete number, a check draws itself when it's valid and the country chip flips over when you change country.

items.name: nebula-glass-card
items.title: Nebula Glass Card
items.description: A frosted glass card floating over a slowly drifting nebula. It tilts toward the pointer on springs with its layers at different depths, a rim light runs round the edge on the pointer's side, and a press dips the card in and flashes the rim before it springs back.

items.name: depth-testimonials
items.title: Depth Testimonials
items.description: Testimonials stacked down a corridor: the front card reads clearly and the rest wait behind it, softer and further away. Next flies the front card past you while the deck surges forward and overshoots, and you can drag the deck to pull it through by hand.

items.name: beam-sweep-field
items.title: Beam Sweep Field
items.description: A dark hero backdrop where columns of light sweep across a fine grid and light up the lines they pass. Move over it and the nearest beam swings onto the pointer, leans into the move and overshoots before drifting back into its sweep.

items.name: vector-tilt-scene
items.title: Vector Tilt Scene
items.description: A card that is really a little diorama: point at it and it tilts toward you while its paper-cut layers spring apart in depth, overshoot and settle. The layers then drift against the pointer for real parallax, and a sheen follows the pointer across the glass label.

items.name: glass-login-stack
items.title: Glass Login Stack
items.description: A frosted login card stacked on two ghost cards over a slow aurora: the stack tilts toward the pointer and the ghosts follow a beat late, so the layers peel apart in depth. Passkey first, then email and password with a remember switch; bad input shakes the card, and success swaps it for a drawn-check welcome.

items.name: signup-form
items.title: Signup Form
items.description: A signup card with floating labels that spring up as you type, password rules that tick green as they are met, and inline errors that shake the field that needs fixing. Submitting squeezes the button into a spinner and swells it back out in green; a matching LoginForm ships alongside it.

items.name: pulse-dashboard-kpis
items.title: Pulse Dashboard KPIs
items.description: A row of KPI cards with a period switcher. Switching period morphs every sparkline into its new shape on a spring, rolls each figure to its new value and flips the delta chips, which know when a drop is good news.

items.name: orbital-loader
items.title: Orbital Loader
items.description: A loader with a comet that laps the ring, speeding up and easing off each lap, its tail stretching with the speed and shrinking as it slows. Give it progress and the arc fills behind the comet; at 100% the ring pops, turns green and draws a tick.

items.name: milestone-timeline
items.title: Milestone Timeline
items.description: A roadmap timeline. When it scrolls into view a glowing bead runs down the rail, drawing each finished milestone's check as it passes, overshoots the milestone in progress slightly and settles on it; clicking a milestone or using the arrow keys slides a raised card to it and opens its notes.

items.name: glow-button
items.title: Glow Button
items.description: A call-to-action link with a coloured light that lives on its rim. The brightest arc turns to face the pointer and the glow behind the button leans the same way, the button drifts a few pixels toward the cursor and the arrow springs ahead on hover.

items.name: three-d-folder
items.title: 3D Folder Card
items.description: A folder card that swings open when you hover, focus or tap it: the front flap falls forward on a spring and up to three papers fan up out of it, each settling with a wobble. Picking a paper grows its cover into a preview dialog you can page through with the arrow keys and close with Escape.

items.name: draggable-card-stack
items.title: Draggable Card Stack
items.description: A pile of photo cards you can fling: grab the top card and throw it any direction and it leans into the throw, flies off, then tucks back under the pile while the next card pops up with a little overshoot. The right arrow sends the top card away and the left arrow pulls the bottom card back; images, videos or drawn scenes all work.

items.name: card-carousel-3d
items.title: 3D Card Carousel
items.description: Product cards standing round a 3D cylinder. Drag or fling it and it coasts, then clicks into place with the nearest card facing you; spin it fast and the cards swing outward and settle back in as it slows, with wheel, arrow keys, dots and a tap on any card also working.

items.name: real-time-cursors
items.title: Real-Time Cursors
items.description: A shared design board with teammates' cursors moving over it live: arrows glide between spots and lean with their speed, name tags trail behind and swing when they stop, stops land as clicks and now and then someone drops a comment. Your own pointer gets a You tag when it comes over the board.

items.name: svg-noise-shader
items.title: SVG Noise Shader
items.description: A grainy gradient surface built from SVG feTurbulence: film grain that flickers over soft pools of colour leaning toward the pointer. Press and hold (or hold Space) and the surface melts through a displacement map; let go and it snaps back like jelly, overshooting before it settles.

items.name: tracing-spotlight-panel
items.title: Tracing Spotlight Panel
items.description: A panel with a light in it: point inside and a soft spotlight trails the pointer on a spring while the border glows wherever the light is closest. Leave and the light slides out to the edge and keeps running laps around the border, tracing the outline until you come back.

items.name: gooey-input
items.title: Gooey Search Input
items.description: A search pill whose icon pinches off into its own bubble through an SVG goo filter when you open it, while the field grows with a springy overshoot. Pass suggestions and the matches drip out of the underside of the field through the same goo, with arrow-key navigation.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Interactive Terminal
items.description: A macOS-style terminal window that types a script of commands with human timing, shows a spinner while each runs and prints its output. Then the prompt is yours: click in and type help, ls, echo or any scripted command, with history, Tab completion and Ctrl+C.

items.name: squiggly-text
items.title: RippleLine squiggly text
items.description: Text that boils like a stop-motion pencil drawing: an SVG turbulence filter re-rolls its noise every few frames, and an optional hand-drawn underline draws itself in. Sweeping the pointer across it stirs the ink, which jumps with pointer speed and settles back on a spring.

items.name: floating-dock
items.title: Nexus floating dock
items.description: A macOS-style dock: tiles swell under the pointer and push their neighbours aside on springs, a tooltip names each one, and a click bounces the tile like a launching app before a running dot slides under it. Below md it turns into one glass button that springs the tiles up as a stack.

items.name: stateful-button
items.title: Stateful message button
items.description: A button that shows its own async work: idle, loading, success and error. Pressed it squashes, a light sweeps across while the promise runs and the label rolls with the width springing to fit; success turns it green with a small overshoot pop and a drawn check, failure turns it red and shakes.

items.name: sparkles
items.title: Sparkles field
items.description: A canvas layer of sparkles that pop in with a small overshoot, turn as they shine, drift and fade, then reappear elsewhere. With interactive on, the pointer leaves a sparkling trail and a click throws a burst that arcs down under gravity.

items.name: text-generate-effect
items.title: Text Generate Effect
items.description: Text that streams in like a model writing it: each word, character or line springs up out of a blur on its own beat and overshoots a hair before settling. A glowing caret rides on the newest token while it generates.

items.name: background-gradient
items.title: Background Gradient
items.description: Wraps a card or button in a slowly turning conic-gradient ring with a soft glow underneath. Hover and the ring spins up while its centre leans toward the pointer; press and the card squashes, springs back past its size and the glow flashes.

items.name: typewriter-effect
items.title: Typewriter Effect
items.description: A typewriter with a physical caret: each new character drops in and settles on a spring, the caret stretches on every keystroke and squashes on every delete, and it only blinks while it waits. Type one phrase, rotate through a list, or loop forever.

items.name: text-reveal-card
items.title: Text Reveal Card
items.description: A card where you scrub a divider across one sentence to swap it for another. The divider follows the pointer on a spring, leans into the direction you move and swings upright when you stop, sheds sparks from the seam, and bounces home when you leave.

items.name: glowing-effect-cards
items.title: Glowing Effect Cards
items.description: Cards wrapped in a hairline rim that lights up on the side nearest the pointer: the lit arc chases the pointer round the edge on a spring, neighbouring cards catch the light as the pointer nears them, and a press flares it. Ships as GlowingEffect (wrap anything), GlowingCard (icon, title, line, call to action) and GlowingCardsLayout (a 2-1-2 grid that stacks by container width).

items.name: infinite-moving-cards
items.title: Infinite Moving Cards
items.description: A belt of cards that cruises sideways forever and fades out at the edges. Hover and it eases to a stop; grab it and fling, and it coasts on your throw, leaning into the speed, before it settles back to cruising.

items.name: meteors
items.title: Meteor Effect
items.description: A canvas layer of meteors that burn in, pick up speed and leave tapering trails across whatever sits behind it. The pointer bends passing meteors toward it, and a click calls one down to strike that spot in a ring of sparks.

items.name: background-boxes
items.title: Background Boxes
items.description: An isometric grid drawn on canvas, set at any skew, scale and rotation. The cell under the pointer pops up like a key in one of the hover colours, overshoots and settles, while a ripple nudges the cells around it.

items.name: encrypted-text
items.title: Encrypted Text
items.description: Text that decodes itself: every character shuffles through a charset in a fixed-width cell so the line never jitters, then a lock wave runs left to right and each character drops into place with a spring pop. Start it on load, on hover, on click or when it scrolls into view, and loop it if you like.

items.name: mac-keyboard
items.title: Mac Keyboard
items.description: A Mac keyboard drawn in HTML, in silver or space grey. Press a key and it sinks, squashes and springs back while a ring of backlight spreads out from it through the gaps; it can listen to the real keyboard, click with synthesised sound and show what you type in a strip above.

items.name: images-badge
items.title: Images Badge
items.description: A pill of overlapping avatars that fans open along a gentle arc on hover or focus, each face springing into place a beat after the last while the +N count rolls down. A name tag glides from face to face under the pointer or the arrow keys, and faces without a picture show initials.

items.name: compare
items.title: Before / After Compare
items.description: A before and after comparison for images or any two pieces of content. Press or drag anywhere and the divider springs to your finger with a little follow-through, the handle stretches in the direction it travels and each label fades as the divider reaches it; arrow keys move it too.

items.name: expandable-cards
items.title: Expandable Cards
items.description: A grid of story cards where picking one grows it, in one continuous spring, into a full card with the long description and a call to action while the rest of the grid sinks back; closing shrinks it home into its slot. It can open over the grid itself or in a centred dialog over the page, and the columns follow the container's width.

items.name: animated-select-headline
items.title: Animated Select Headline
items.description: A headline where one word sits inside a design-tool selection box, and every few seconds a different collaborator selects the next word. The box springs to the new width with an elastic overshoot, the size badge counts the pixels live, and the collaborator's cursor trails the corner on a softer spring.

items.name: circular-carousel
items.title: Circular Carousel
items.description: Cards hung round the rim of a wheel, with the active card at the top and its neighbours tipping away down each side. Drag or fling the wheel and it coasts to the nearest card while the cards swing on their pins and settle, and the counter in the middle rolls to the new number; arrows, dots and keys work too.

items.name: chat-messages
items.title: Chat Messages
items.description: A chat thread styled like a messaging app, with blue user bubbles, grey replies and a composer. With autoplay the conversation plays itself: user lines type into the composer and pop out, and the assistant's typing dots grow into each reply; visitors can then send their own messages.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A syntax-highlighted code block with a title bar, language badge, line numbers and a copy button. A soft bar glides between lines as the pointer moves, highlightLines marks lines with an accent bar, and copying turns the icon into a tick that draws itself.

items.name: card-stack-rotator
items.title: Card Stack Rotator
items.description: A stack of testimonial cards: flick the top card away and it flies out, drops behind the pile and slides home into the back slot with a wobble. The next card rises and its **highlighted** words get a fresh highlighter stroke.

items.name: scroll-reveal-text
items.title: Scroll Reveal Text
items.description: A paragraph that reads itself as you scroll: each word, character or line rises out of a blur and passes through the accent colour on its way from grey to ink, so a bright reading wave travels through the text. Scroll progress is smoothed by a spring, and it can track the page or any scrollable container.

items.name: animated-countdown
items.title: Animated Countdown
items.description: Flip-style countdown timer with four variants — modern, digital, minimal, and classic. Smooth number transitions powered by Framer Motion. Also includes the Motion Kit Split-Flap Board variant.

items.name: hover-highlight-text
items.title: Hover Highlight Text
items.description: A headline you read with a highlighter: words near the pointer turn from grey to ink and a marker stroke swipes in under each one with a small overshoot. As the pointer moves on, the strokes linger and retract one after another like a comet tail.

items.name: motion-layer-scroller
items.title: Motion Layer Scroller
items.description: A landscape built from paper-cut layers inside its own scroll frame: scroll through it and each ridge rises at its own speed while the sun sinks behind them. When you stop, the layers settle on a soft spring with a small overshoot; pass your own layers to build any parallax scene.

items.name: spectra-frame
items.title: Spectra Frame
items.description: A photo grid that rests in black and white. Pointing at a photo blooms colour out from where the pointer came in while the photo widens, its row grows and the rest dim; moving off drains the colour back to where the pointer left.

items.name: profile-orbit
items.title: Profile Orbit
items.description: A profile card with the whole team orbiting it on a tilted ring. Dragging the ring, using the arrows or tapping a face spins that person round to the front, the card slides over to them and their avatar drops in with a bounce, while people at the back of the ring pass under the card.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: Animated command palette that opens with ⌘K: a dimmed overlay, a search field that filters a list of commands, and Framer Motion enter and exit transitions. Also includes the Motion Kit Command Morph variant.

items.name: image-trail
items.title: Image Trail
items.description: Move across the area and it deals out photos along your path: each lands with a small overshoot, tilted the way you were heading, carries a bit of your speed, then drops away under gravity, blurring as it fades. Turn on the magnetic effect and the pointer shoves the photos that are still lying there.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar Group
items.description: An overlapping stack of avatars that behaves like a dock: the face under the pointer swells and rises, its neighbours lean out of the way and a single name pill glides from face to face. Past a maximum a +N chip opens the rest, and every avatar is focusable from the keyboard.

items.name: feature-tools-card
items.title: Feature Tools Card
items.description: An integrations card: five tool icons ride a slow ring round your app's hub, each wired to it by a line that carries small packets inward. Bring the pointer near and the tools lean toward it like magnets, their line lights up and they snap back with a wobble when it moves away, while the whole card tilts toward the pointer.

items.name: link-preview
items.title: Link Preview
items.description: An inline link that lifts a preview card out of the text on hover or keyboard focus. The card rises with a stretch and settles, leans and slides as the pointer moves along the link, and draws its own cover from the title and site when no image is given.

items.name: toast-stack
items.title: Toast Stack
items.description: Notifications that rest in a tidy stack: a new toast drops onto the pile squashed and springs into shape, and hover or focus fans the stack into a list. Fling a toast sideways and it tilts and skids off; with a duration set, the front toast counts down along its bottom edge and waits while the stack is open.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: A six-box one-time-code field: digits spring in as you type, the boxes ripple while the code is checked, shake on a wrong code, and fold into a Verified pill on success.

items.name: radio-cards
items.title: Radio Cards
items.description: A plan picker built on real radio inputs: the selection ring glides between cards, the chosen card opens to show its features, and the button label rolls to the new plan.

items.name: password-strength
items.title: Password Strength
items.description: A password field with a four-segment meter that fills and recolours as you type, a rolling strength label, rules that tick themselves off, and an eye toggle that draws its own slash.

items.name: animated-tabs
items.title: Animated Tabs
items.description: A settings panel with a sliding segmented control: rows slide in from the side you moved towards, the panel resizes to fit, and each row has an iOS-style switch whose knob stretches while pressed.

items.name: rotating-headline
items.title: Rotating Headline
items.description: A hero headline whose words arrive one by one out of a blur, ending on a word that keeps rolling to the next, with a subline that follows word by word and a replay button.

items.name: feedback-pill
items.title: Feedback Pill
items.description: A small Feedback pill that morphs into a note form, shows a spinner in the Send button while it posts, then shrinks into a thank-you before folding back into the pill.

items.name: stagger-menu
items.title: Stagger Menu
items.description: A share menu that unfolds from its button with the items arriving one after another, a highlight that glides between rows, arrow-key navigation, and a button label that rolls to confirm what you picked.

items.name: elastic-stepper
items.title: Elastic Stepper
items.description: A plus / minus stepper whose number rolls up or down, with a dot track that stretches to the current value and a rubber-band bounce when you push past either limit.

items.name: progress-button
items.title: Progress Button
items.description: A button that becomes its own progress bar: it stretches, fills as the work runs with a live percentage, then turns green with a drawn check and a new label.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Two copy controls: an ID chip whose icon morphs into a check under a ripple and a Copied tooltip, and a command line whose button rolls from Copy to Copied.

items.name: capsule-toggles
items.title: Capsule Toggles
items.description: Switches built as a ball sealed in a glass capsule. Flip one and the ball stretches into a pill mid-flight, then takes on the row's colour and glows as it lands.

items.name: cinematic-logo-cloud
items.title: Cinematic Logo Cloud
items.description: Social proof with a cinematic entrance: each logo blurs into view in turn, then a soft spotlight follows the pointer and the logos it passes resolve from grey into crisp ink and lift. The marquee variants drift on their own, ease off under the pointer, and can be dragged and flung.

items.name: step-flow
items.title: Step Flow
items.description: A process section with numbered steps beside a deck of cards. Picking a step by hover, click or arrow keys slides the highlight to it on a spring and deals its card to the front while the old card tucks under the back of the deck; with autoplay a progress bar fills under the active step.

items.name: float-glass-navbar
items.title: Float Glass Navbar
items.description: A floating glass navigation bar: a soft lens slides under the link you point at, thinning as it travels and stretching as it lands, then glides back to the active link. Once the page scrolls it tucks itself into a compact pill, and when the links no longer fit they fold into a springy menu.

items.name: orbit-footer
items.title: Orbit Footer
items.description: A complete site footer with brand, a newsletter signup, link columns with badges, a live status pill and social links. Under it a giant ghost wordmark rises from behind the legal bar, and its letters lift and ink in like a wave following the pointer.

items.name: toggle-pricing-pro
items.title: Toggle Pricing
items.description: Pricing cards with a monthly and yearly switch. The knob squashes and stretches with its own speed as it slides, the saving badge pops in, and every price rolls digit by digit to its new figure with a small overshoot.

items.name: split-signup-convert
items.title: Split Signup Convert
items.description: A two-panel signup: a lit value panel with the pitch and benefits, and a short form with Google and GitHub buttons, an email that confirms itself, and a password whose four-segment strength meter pops each segment in. As the form fills, the benefits on the left tick themselves off and a progress line grows under them.

items.name: workbench-sidebar
items.title: Workbench Sidebar
items.description: A product sidebar with a workspace switcher, a search that filters the list as you type, a highlight that springs between rows, projects, a usage meter and the signed-in user. Collapsing springs it down to an icon rail while the labels trail after the width one row at a time.

items.name: lattice-feature-grid
items.title: Lattice Feature Grid
items.description: A feature grid drawn on a hairline lattice. The hairlines catch a soft blue light that follows the pointer, and the tile under it plays its small illustration: colour swatches fan out, a spring ball lands and settles, a focus ring hops between buttons and a search result climbs to first place.

items.name: motion-faq-disclosure
items.title: Motion FAQ Disclosure
items.description: A two-column FAQ with a heading and support card on one side and an accessible accordion on the other. Opening a question lifts it out of the list into a raised card with a slight overshoot, spins its plus into a minus and unfolds the answer a sentence at a time.

items.name: editorial-blog-rail
items.title: Editorial Blog Rail
items.description: A magazine-style blog rail: a featured story with generated cover art beside a numbered list of recent posts. Pointing at or focusing a post turns the featured slot into its preview: the cover blooms into that post's colours, the title and excerpt slide in, and the lines on the cover drift with the pointer.

items.name: split-contact-glass
items.title: Split Contact Glass
items.description: A contact section in two panes: a glass panel with the team's local time on a springy analog clock, a one-tap copyable email and the reply time, and a form with name, email, topic chips and a message whose count ring fills as you type. Sending launches the paper plane off the button and swaps the form for a thank-you.

items.name: pricing-section
items.title: Pricing Section
items.description: Four interactive pricing layouts with radio selection, animated monthly and yearly billing transitions, and configurable feature lists.

items.name: logo-clouds
items.title: Brand Logo Animation
items.description: A complete set of animated logo cloud layouts including marquee, spotlight, swapping, and blur variants.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Simple, collapsible, and grouped animated sidebar navigation layouts.

items.name: contact-page
items.title: Contact Page
items.description: Contact block variants with forms, social links, imagery, and the included Nexus mark.

items.name: blog-content-sections
items.title: Blog Content Sections
items.description: Centered article, table-of-contents, editorial, featured post, and hover-card blog sections.

items.name: footer-blocks
items.title: Footer Blocks
items.description: A site footer with link columns, newsletter, status and a lit wordmark.

items.name: signup-blocks
items.title: Sign-up Blocks
items.description: A split sign-up page with a self-ticking checklist and a strength meter.
